description: Defines classes for iterating over DNS servers for different DNS transaction types, including general, DoH, and classic DNS, with mechanisms to handle server eligibility based on failure limits and availability.

classes.name: DnsServerIterator
classes.description: Abstract base class for iterating over DNS servers, managing attempt counts and failure limits.

classes.name: DohDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class for iterating over DoH (DNS over HTTPS) servers with additional secure DNS mode handling.

classes.name: ClassicDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class for iterating over traditional DNS servers.

methods.name: GetNextAttemptIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the next server to attempt.

methods.name: AttemptAvailable
methods.description: Checks if there are any servers still available for attempts.

calls: DnsServerIterator(size_t, size_t, int, int, const ResolveContext*, const DnsSession*)
DohDnsServerIterator(size_t, size_t, int, int, const SecureDnsMode&, const ResolveContext*, const DnsSession*)
